description: Said the weaver's part the way Kemp fills a yard

participation.context: Spoke it twice and turned to the clean sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You tried the weaver's going and coming at the size of the yard, and you set the page to begin with the workmen. You kept the girl's line for the leaf, and you did not count the pile.

title: Tried the weaver's lines in a bigger voice

description: Wiped the tables and wrote four lines

participation.context: Wrote the four lines and did not add a fifth.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept the morning's order and left the rest of the leaf blank.

title: Wiped the tables down to four lines

description: Started the sheet with the workmen in the wood

participation.context: Wrote the page, read it back, and left the blank.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You filled the clean sheet from the rehearsal in the wood to the queen waking, and you stopped at the foot of the leaf. The two lines went in as they stand. You did not write a punishment under the question, and you did not number the leaves under the page.

title: Wrote the page from the workmen through to the queen

description: A clean sheet

participation.context: Laid the sheet and did not open the pile.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You did not number the leaves under the new one. You put your hand on the blank corner and stopped there.

title: Set a clean sheet on the desk

description: Joined the workmen to the queen who wakes

participation.context: Wrote to the foot of the leaf and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote one page from the rehearsal to the waking. You used the two lines as they stand. You did not write an ending, and you did not number the pile.

title: Wrote the page from the workmen to the queen

description: Said the page joins the two beginnings

participation.context: Spoke the refusal and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You named the join and refused the number. You went down to dinner.

title: Named the page and went down to dinner

description: Turned the leaf face down and shut the Chaucer

participation.context: Looked at the edges and did not count them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You turned your own leaf down on the older ones and did not number them. You shut the Chaucer. The letter stayed flat behind the pile.

title: Turned the morning's leaf face down

description: Read the open leaf and left the pen down

participation.context: Read the leaf in the afternoon light and left the pen in the rest.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the open leaf from the workmen to the question, and you left the blank. You did not fold it yet, and you did not number the pile.

title: Read the morning's leaf again in the afternoon

description: Said the blank under the queen was yours to fill

participation.context: Said it and turned back.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stood in the porch while the light went, looked at the plain chest, and turned back across the close. You did not take a next line from the stone.

title: Stood in the porch and turned back

description: Folded the morning's leaf onto the older ones

participation.context: Folded the sheet with the inked hand and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You made one packet and you did not turn the older leaves up to number them.

title: Folded the morning's leaf onto the pile

description: Wrote that the queen wakes, and stopped

participation.context: Wrote the two sentences and left them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the refusal on a small leaf. You did not turn it into the page you had just folded.

title: Wrote two sentences about the queen's question

description: Read those two sentences and left the pile folded

participation.context: Read the two sentences and left the pen down.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the note back and did not write an ending under it. The folded pile and the letter stayed as they were until you went down to the stair.

title: Read the two sentences on the note

description: Wrote that the packet goes and the letter stays

participation.context: Wrote the four lines and did not add a fifth.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote four lines for the going out, folded the packet, and left the letter on the board. You took the pages and not the sheet.

title: Wrote what goes out and what stays

description: The packet under the cloak

participation.context: Held the fold shut and faced the door.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You lit the lantern and you did not put the letter under the cloak with the leaves.

title: Took the packet under the cloak

description: Passed the shut bookstalls at Paul's

participation.context: Spoke as he walked and did not stop.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You passed the shut stalls at Paul's, the White Greyhound with its boards up, and you did not stop to buy a book.

title: Passed the shut stalls at Paul's

description: Sat at Field's before the packet was opened

participation.context: Set the leaves on the settle and had not unfolded them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the pages by the fire and did not open them yet. The cups were already there.

title: Set the leaves down by the fire

description: Sat by the fire with the packet folded

participation.context: Sat with the fold shut.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the closed packet by the cups and sat. You did not unfold it until you were asked what you had brought.

title: Sat down by the fire before the pages were opened

description: Read the pages at Field's fire

participation.context: Read, refused an ending, and answered the pay and the chronicle plainly.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Lost his straight face, preferred a plain no to a flourish, and blessed you and the book.
participation.name: Richard Field

participation.context: Asked the question, forbade the punishment, and kept the count honest.
participation.name: Jacqueline Field

relations.note: Warwickshire in the page, and the chronicle still out
relations.quote: God keep thee, then, and it.

story.body: You read the pages by the sea-coal fire, a dozen leaves and no last act. Field laughed and wiped his eyes. Jacqueline told you not to punish the queen. You said you had not been paid. The chronicle stays at Great St Helen's. You stayed on after good night, looked into the press-room, and left when the leaf was shut, the pages in the same fold.

relations.note: Warwickshire in the page, and the chronicle still out
relations.quote: God keep thee, then, and it.

title: Read the pages by Field's fire

description: The leaf by the fire

participation.context: Held the leaf open and did not write on it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You held the morning's leaf open in the firelight. The blank under the question was still blank. You did not write on it.

title: Held the morning's leaf open by the fire

description: Looked in at the cold bar of the press

participation.context: Stood in the doorway and did not go to the press.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You did not put a sheet on it, and you did not touch the bar.

title: Looked into the press-room

description: Reported a dozen leaves from Field's

participation.context: Said it once and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: Back at the lodging you said the dozen, the blank, and that you had not started an ending. The chronicle was on the shelf. The letter was still on the board.

title: Came back to the letter on the board
